Claim registered with Senate Mining Bureau; further exploration recommended.|[[Hugo Bartyn]]'s field report to [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|ORO]]|<ref name="Bartyn's Landing (article)">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>}}
The '''Senate Mining Bureau''' was a body active five centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

At that point, agents of the [[exploratory branch of Outer Rim Oreworks]] were supposed to register a claim with the Senate Mining Bureau when they found a planet they wanted ORO to own. [[Hugo Bartyn]] was so experienced that he registered claims with the Bureau before even reporting to ORO.
